name: 火口の山
notes: Broad charcoal volcanic mountain with an open summit crater and source orange lava. The 13,382-triangle main mesh retains silhouette, opening and radial channels. Further QEM LODs show folded slopes and black facet patches and are REJECTED for delivery; source files and browser failures remain archived. The two placed mountains share the accepted main geometry at every visible distance. This still removes over 95% of dense triangles, without substituting a broken model. Matte dielectric rock with local lava glow. Source internal/seam topology warnings remain recorded; no watertight claim.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction, source-derived reduction and separate revisions.
